scenario.topic: Choose a charity for the company donation drive
scenario.opening_question: What balance of impact, transparency, and local involvement matters most for our donation?

options.name: City Food Bank Emergency Relief Fund
options.upside: Directly addresses urgent hunger in the local community
options.tradeoff: Limited long-term systemic change beyond immediate relief
options.concern: Some worry about dependency rather than sustainable solutions
options.best_for: urgent local aid and measurable short-term impact

options.name: Clean Water Initiative for Rural Schools
options.upside: Improves health and education outcomes in underserved rural areas
options.tradeoff: Longer project timeline delays visible results
options.concern: Less immediate impact felt by urban employees
options.best_for: sustainable health improvements and education support

options.name: Veterans Mental Health Support Program
options.upside: Addresses critical mental health needs for veterans
options.tradeoff: Smaller beneficiary group compared to other options
options.concern: May not resonate with all employees’ values or interests
options.best_for: focused support for vulnerable veteran populations

options.name: Tech Access for Low-Income Youth
options.upside: Bridges digital divide with technology and skills training
options.tradeoff: Requires ongoing support beyond initial donation for lasting impact
options.concern: Effectiveness depends on partner organizations’ capacity
options.best_for: long-term educational empowerment and digital inclusion

shared_context: The decision group has exactly 3 participants
The goal is to maximize positive community impact within one fiscal quarter
